 * @param {number} guess - The initial guess for the integer square root.

function int_rac(n, guess) {
    let approximations = [];
    while (true) {
        approximations.push(guess);
        let newGuess = Math.floor((guess + n / guess) / 2);

        }
        guess = newGuess;
    }
    return approximations.length;
